trigger.description: A query needs a cached peer body and policy allows body fetch, but the remote body is not available at fetch time, so ee keeps the peer material metadata-only and reports the unavailable remote body without silently inventing local content.
setup_commands: ee mesh peer add --workspace . --peer peer_mesh_body_allowed --grant metadata --grant body --json

expected_emission.repair_string: Retry mesh sync or fetch after the peer advertises the body; until then, use metadata-only context.
